summary: Iteration 24 — Tested Accounts refactor (meter_reading dropped, operational_expense + gst_input added), Expenses sub-tab, CEO Dashboard 4-card grid + Net Cash Flow, and What3Words GPS auto-fill. Backend pytest: 8/9 pass (1 real product bug). Frontend UI: sidebar 'Accounts' label, credits-title='Accounts', 3 tabs, default Customer Credits tab, CEO Dashboard all 7 data-testid cards render with correct amounts (Op Exp MTD=₹70,000, GST=₹36,000, Net Cash Flow=₹1,06,000 red tone), W3W GPS button fetches https://api.what3words.com/v3/convert-to-3wa with coordinates=51.521251,-0.203586&key=G4IVNNAW, auto-fills what3words-input='filled.count.soap', renders w3w-coords '51.52125, -0.20359' + 'Open in W3W ↗' link, and shows w3w-error 'Location permission denied...' when geolocation code:1.

critical.issue: Missing top-level keys 'operational_expense_mtd' and 'gst_input_mtd'. Review_request explicitly requires summary to include MTD totals. Currently only returns per-type snapshot dicts. Result: frontend ExpensesSection (which calls accountsAPI.summary()) displays ₹0 for both Operational Expense (MTD) and GST Input (MTD) cards AND ₹0 for Total Outflow, even though underlying entries exist. CEO Dashboard is unaffected because it uses _ceo_accounts_summary() which DOES compute these at server.py:2526-2528.
critical.fix_hint: server.py:4144 accounts_summary() — add MTD computation similar to _ceo_accounts_summary (server.py:2502-2528). Aggregate amount where entry_type in ('operational_expense','gst_input') AND entry_date within current month, add as top-level keys 'operational_expense_mtd'/'gst_input_mtd'.

minor.issue: Response returns only {id, message} with no echo of the created entry (entry_type/amount/entry_date). Not a product bug per se but makes client confirmation harder and breaks the review_request's implicit 'returns created entry' contract. Tests had to do GET /api/accounts?entry_type=... to verify persistence.

integration_issues.issue: exp-snapshot-op and exp-snapshot-gst display ₹0 even when entries exist because they read operational_expense_mtd/gst_input_mtd from /api/accounts/summary which doesn't return those keys. Same root cause as backend critical bug above.

issues: Net Cash Flow value displays as positive '₹1,06,000' without a minus sign even when the underlying computed value is -1,06,000 (outflow > inflow). The red-tone styling + 'Outflow exceeds cash inflow — review' subtitle convey the sign, but the numeric ₹ display loses sign. Consider formatting as '-₹1,06,000' or '(₹1,06,000)' when net_cash_flow_mtd < 0.

action_items: [HIGH] Fix /api/accounts/summary to compute and return operational_expense_mtd + gst_input_mtd top-level keys (aggregate sum of entries where entry_type in those two types AND entry_date in current calendar month). Currently ExpensesSection MTD cards show ₹0 while CEO dashboard shows correct values — inconsistent UX. Mirror the logic from server.py:2502-2528 _ceo_accounts_summary.
[MEDIUM] CEO netflow card — format negative net_cash_flow_mtd with explicit minus sign ('-₹1,06,000') so users immediately see sign; current display is magnitude-only relying on red tint + subtitle.
[LOW] Consider returning the created entry object (not just {id,message}) from POST /api/accounts for client-side optimistic updates.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:4144 accounts_summary() is inconsistent with _ceo_accounts_summary (server.py:2502) — the latter computes *_mtd + net_cash_flow_mtd, former does not. Both should share a helper to avoid drift.

frontend/src/components/ExpensesSection.js:80-81 reads summary?.operational_expense_mtd but backend never emits it. The component silently falls back to 0 rather than showing a 'data unavailable' state — consider loading skeleton or error banner when MTD key is missing from response.
SiteVisitForm.js:259-261 reads process.env.REACT_APP_W3W_API_KEY at call-time; no guard if key is undefined (would send 'key=undefined'). Add a null-check + clearer error.

POST /api/accounts response shape ({id, message}) differs from the GET list shape (full entry). Consider returning the full created entry for consistency — current asymmetry makes testing and client-side cache updates harder.

rca of the issue: Root cause of ExpensesSection ₹0 snapshot: /api/accounts/summary endpoint (server.py line 4144-4161) only iterates ACCOUNT_TYPES and returns per-type latest-entry snapshots. It does NOT compute month-to-date aggregates. The MTD computation exists only in _ceo_accounts_summary (server.py lines 2502-2528) and is embedded in /api/dashboard/ceo response. Frontend ExpensesSection calls accountsAPI.summary() (= /api/accounts/summary) and reads summary?.operational_expense_mtd || 0 — the short-circuit to 0 masks the missing-key bug. Fix: duplicate or refactor MTD aggregation to run inside /api/accounts/summary handler. Reproduction: seed an operational_expense entry for today (POST /api/accounts with entry_type=operational_expense, entry_date=TODAY, amount=35000) then GET /api/accounts/summary — response will have key 'operational_expense' (snapshot) but NOT 'operational_expense_mtd'.
